task.speaker: client
task.text:
Whether both purchase scenarios share the same modal determines the copy. If they do, the 'Mint successful' message will need to be more generic; otherwise, a referral-code purchase will need different copy.

For purchases without a code, the current message works nicely because it reminds buyers that simply holding the NFT could one day result in receiving a random ticket and commission too. That reminder only makes sense for mints without a referral code.

Separately, the book title looks good in small caps.
